message.content:
The loop assumes segments arrive in ascending order. If `segno` is smaller than `last` (or larger than expected), `missing` can be negative or the index `segno` can exceed the grown size, so `a->segments[segno]` writes out of bounds. The unchecked indexing is the core flaw.

Answer: 11
